title: About Us
content:
About MERU Global Team

Reaching the unreached, connecting generations to the Great Commission.

Our Founding Purpose & Global Reach

The MERU Global Team is committed to carrying Christ’s name into places where He is yet unknown. Our focus is on building strong foundations in the Word of God, equipping believers to live out their faith and share the Gospel across nations.

By connecting people worldwide to the Great Commission, MERU empowers Christians of every generation in their faith and to become witnesses of Christ’s love in communities that remain unreached.

Organizational Profile & Milestones

  • 2012 Founded: Established as an international missions movement following the historic Unreached People Groups (UPG) Conference at ASCM.
  • 45+ Countries Active: Collaborative operations across Latin America, East Asia, the European Union, and East Africa.
  • 10,000+ Alumni Network: Next-generation ambassadors and leaders serving across church ministries and educational institutions.

Core Strategic Anchors

  1. Training Programs: Equipping believers with biblical knowledge, cross-cultural skills, and practical tools to stand firm in faith and share the Gospel effectively.
  2. Conferences: Gathering Christians from across nations and generations to be inspired, strengthened, and mobilized through teaching, worship, and fellowship.
  3. Building Bridges: Building connections across cultures, denominations, and organizations to open pathways for mission work and foster unity in reaching the unreached.

Leadership & Governance

Our international operations are guided by an experienced executive board and academic council dedicated to theological integrity, ethical administration, and sustainable field logistics.

title: History
content:
Our Journey Timeline

Milestones & Archival Legacy of the MERU Global Team

From an initial vision at the Asian Seminary of Christian Ministries to a worldwide missionary movement, explore our foundational timeline and photo records.

Key Historical Milestones

  • 2010 – UPG Conference at ASCM: The Unreached People Groups conference became the seedbed for MERU. Keynote presentations inspired new partnerships that laid the groundwork for our global network.
  • 2010 – Birth of Partnerships: Cross-denominational collaborations formed among missionary directors, educators, and field workers to formulate effective UPG strategies.
  • 2011 – Doctoral Research Project: Foundational field research on Christian Missions for the Unreached (CMU) was conducted among indigenous communities in Palanan, Isabela, Philippines, focusing on gospel inculturation.
  • 2012 – Formation of MERU Global Team: Officially instituted to serve unreached missions worldwide, connecting new generations to the Great Commission.
  • 2020 – Global Expansion: Spread to nations across Europe, Latin America, East Asia, and Africa, inaugurating international conferences, academic exchange seminars, and youth summits.

Archival snapshots and videos for each historical event slot can be uploaded and managed directly in the dedicated History Slots section.

title: Programs
content:
Training & Mission Programs

Academic Catalog & Global Exchange Portfolios

Explore our accredited seminars, youth leadership summits, and cross-cultural field initiatives designed to equip Christians for global impact and missionary service.

Portfolio Categories

  • Academic Exchanges: Intensive 4-week cultural immersion and technical research seminars hosted in partnership with universities in Tokyo, Munich, and London. Includes ECTS academic credits.
  • Corporate Responsibility & Ethics: Professional roundtable forums addressing corporate governance, ESG alignment, and Christian ethical leadership in global commerce.
  • Civic Youth Leadership: High-impact summits, public speaking workshops, and mentorship initiatives preparing youth ambassadors for civic and international leadership.
  • Field Research & Humanitarian Logistics: Hands-on operational training in field logistics, translation services, and humanitarian community outreach.

You can edit specific program cards, dates, featured photos, and video trailers in the Programs management dashboard.
